taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-20, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 64.6 | 2.65 | 2.65
2 | 775.4 | 0.67 | 3.32
3 | 110.3 | 1.09 | 4.41
4 | 222.5 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we examine the resistivities of the layers in groups of three consecutive layers.

The resistivity values are:
$\rho_1 = 64.6$
$\rho_2 = 775.4$
$\rho_3 = 110.3$
$\rho_4 = 222.5$

**1. First group (Layers 1-2-3):**
Comparing $\rho_1$, $\rho_2$, and $\rho_3$:
$64.6 < 775.4$ and $775.4 > 110.3$.
Since $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$, this matches the definition for **K**.

**2. Second group (Layers 2-3-4):**
Comparing $\rho_2$, $\rho_3$, and $\rho_4$:
$775.4 > 110.3$ and $110.3 < 222.5$.
Since $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$, this matches the definition for **H**.

Combining these letters in depth order, we get **KH**.

{"curve_type": "KH"}
